## Public Handoff Checklist

- [ ] Root README first-run flow reviewed.
- [ ] `AI_OPERATOR_SETUP.md` reviewed for safe AI-operator guidance.
- [ ] No private live directives or generated workspace artifacts included.
- [ ] No pending LLM directives, runtime ledgers, spill-volume state, or `.env` files included.
- [ ] `scripts/public_handoff_hygiene.ps1` passes.
- [ ] Python compile checks pass for shipped helper scripts.
- [ ] Screenshots are sanitized and do not show private runtime data.
- [ ] License, notice, commercial use, trademark, security, and contribution docs remain consistent.
